headline: Oregon State top the table on a run of wins
dek: Oregon State have scored 50 goals across all their matches, more than any other programme, and have not lost since a defeat at Utah Valley in October. California Baptist alone match their twelve wins, and have conceded fewer goals than anyone.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Oregon State's 50 goals stand apart: the other programmes sit far closer to one another than any of them sits to the leaders, so the scoring in this conference is one side and a pack.

wire.line: Wyatt Borso has 15 goals for Oregon State, more than any other player in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: San Diego State have drawn nine of their matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: California Baptist have conceded 18 goals, fewer than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fourteen different players have scored for Oregon State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have passed their date with no result, UC San Diego's August home matches against San Diego, Arizona Western and Grand Canyon among them.

last_match.line: Oregon State have now beaten Cal State Bakersfield, the side that won at their ground in October.

next_match.line: Oregon State's September visits to Georgetown and Virginia brought a defeat and a draw.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
